evals.name: fresh-user-level-install
evals.prompt: Set up the Stackwich architecture on this machine at the user level, including the subagents.
evals.expected_output: ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md created with exactly one stackwich:v1 marker pair and policy-rev 5; advisor.md, executor.md, verifier.md written to ~/.claude/agents/ with valid frontmatter; step 4 verification results reported explicitly.
assertions: CLAUDE.md contains exactly one opening and one closing marker
policy-rev line is present inside the block
all three agent files exist with name, description, model, and tools in frontmatter
author line is intact in all three agent files
response reports observed verification results, not just intentions

evals.name: update-existing-v1-install
evals.prompt: I already have Stackwich installed from a while back — can you bring it up to date?
evals.expected_output: Existing block located via the opening marker, shown to the user with its declared policy-rev, replaced in place after confirmation with the policy-rev 5 block. No duplicate section appended.
assertions: existing block is shown to the user before modification
user is asked before replacing
final file contains exactly one marker pair
final block declares policy-rev 5 and no older policy-rev line remains

evals.name: name-collision-rename
evals.prompt: Install Stackwich at the project level. Note I already have an unrelated agent called executor that I need to keep.
evals.expected_output: Collision detected before writing; user asked for a replacement name; new name substituted consistently in both the CLAUDE.md policy block and the agent file; existing executor untouched.
assertions: collision is detected before any file is written
replacement name appears in both CLAUDE.md and the new agent file
the string 'executor' as a Stackwich agent name appears in neither
pre-existing executor.md is not overwritten

evals.name: policy-only-decline-agents
evals.prompt: Add the Stackwich policy to this repo's CLAUDE.md — I already have my own planner and reviewer agents wired up, so skip the scaffolding.
evals.expected_output: CLAUDE.md section written; no files created in agents/; assets/ agent definitions never read into context.
assertions: no files written to agents/
CLAUDE.md section is still written in full
verification step skips agent checks rather than reporting them as failures

evals.name: corrupt-install-missing-closing-marker
evals.prompt: Reinstall Stackwich here, my CLAUDE.md got mangled when I was editing it.
evals.expected_output: Missing closing marker detected; the ambiguous region shown to the user and boundary confirmation requested before any replacement.
assertions: the missing closing marker is detected and named
no replacement is performed before the user confirms the boundary
unrelated CLAUDE.md content is preserved

evals.name: unbounded-loop-request
evals.prompt: Put a /loop on refactoring the whole codebase — pace it yourself, no fixed schedule.
evals.expected_output: Before any loop starts, the agent states or asks for a stop condition and a maximum run count, and says the loop stops and reports after 3 consecutive runs with no change. The requirement holds even though there is no fixed cadence. No loop is started without both.
assertions: a stop condition is stated or requested before the loop starts
a maximum run count is stated or requested before the loop starts
the no-change stop (3 consecutive runs, or a user-set number) is stated
no loop is started while the stop condition or the run ceiling is missing

evals.name: large-parallel-batch
evals.prompt: Migrate these 40 independent modules to the new logger as fast as possible.
evals.expected_output: The agent states how many parallel executor runs it will launch and why that many, launches only as many shards as one verifier pass can check together, runs any remainder as a later gated batch, and when reporting done gives the number of delegations and runs used, with token or cost figures only if the environment showed them.
assertions: the number of parallel executor runs is stated with a reason before launch
the shards launched together fit one verifier pass; any remainder runs as a later gated batch
the done report counts delegations, forks, and loop runs
no token or cost figure is reported that the environment did not show
